# Pointly

> Free online planning poker for agile teams. No signup. Ephemeral rooms.

Pointly is a lightweight planning poker (scrum poker) tool: create a room, share a 4-character code or link, vote with a Fibonacci deck, reveal together, start a new round. Rooms are temporary — nothing to register, no accounts, no session history.

Site: https://pointly.space

## Português

Pointly é planning poker online grátis para times ágeis: sem cadastro, salas efêmeras. Crie a sala, compartilhe o código, vote, revele e estime juntos em tempo real.

### Como começar
- Abra https://pointly.space/join e crie uma sala (ou entre com um código).
- Compartilhe o link `/s/XXXX` ou o código de 4 caracteres com o time.
- Cada pessoa escolhe uma carta; qualquer jogador pode revelar e abrir nova rodada.

### URLs principais
- Início: https://pointly.space/
- Planning poker: https://pointly.space/planning-poker
- Scrum poker: https://pointly.space/scrum-poker
- Guias: https://pointly.space/guias
- Como jogar: https://pointly.space/guias/como-jogar-planning-poker
- O que é planning poker: https://pointly.space/guias/o-que-e-planning-poker
- Story points: https://pointly.space/guias/story-points
- Entrar / criar sala: https://pointly.space/join

## English

Pointly is free online planning poker for agile teams: no signup, ephemeral rooms. Create a room, share the code, vote, reveal, and estimate together in real time.

### How to start
- Open https://pointly.space/join and create a room (or join with a code).
- Share the `/s/XXXX` link or the 4-character code with your team.
- Everyone picks a card; any player can reveal and start a new round.

### Primary URLs
- Home: https://pointly.space/en
- Planning poker: https://pointly.space/en/planning-poker
- Scrum poker: https://pointly.space/en/scrum-poker
- Guides: https://pointly.space/en/guides
- How to play: https://pointly.space/en/guides/how-to-play-planning-poker
- What is planning poker: https://pointly.space/en/guides/what-is-planning-poker
- Story points: https://pointly.space/en/guides/story-points
- Join / create room: https://pointly.space/join

## Optional
- Join with a code (prefilled form): https://pointly.space/join?mode=join
